name: Austral-Pediment
description: Grass-plains and basalt shields alternate across the habitable belt, stitched together by ancient meteor crater. Farther poleward, past orbital debris ring, the silence feels older than the soil.

Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound. Carpet-flora blooms all at once after each rare rain, turning whole basins scarlet overnight.
The descent was survivable; what came after was not. Salvage rights to starship crash site (warship) are contested by three claimants, two of them dead.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
